cypher: MERGE (n:Entity {uuid: $uuid}) ON CREATE SET n.name = $name, n.group_id = $group_id, n.name_embedding = $name_embedding, n.summary = $summary, n.attributes = $attributes
MERGE (n:Episodic {uuid: $uuid}) ON CREATE SET n.name = $name, n.group_id = $group_id, n.content = $content, n.content_embedding = $content_embedding, n.entity_edges = $entity_edges
MERGE (r:RelatesToNode_ {uuid: $uuid}) ON CREATE SET r.name = $name, r.fact = $fact, r.fact_embedding = $fact_embedding, r.episodes = $episodes
